labels.notes: The label is unmarked and the row stays partial, as the dispatch requires. The ledger regex (tools/ledger.py docstring_label_re, **`(prefix):label`**, read on text[:4000]) finds no mark. The only bold-backticked tokens are the declaration names **`GX.troyanovTheorem_of_lt_two_pi`** (char 784) and **`GX.SphPolygon.isConeSphere`** (char 1905). Bold declaration names are house style, and the ledger does not read them. The label bullet sits at char 314, unmarked, and cites `RamcovGX.tex:1930`, the \begin{cex} line. The quoted block matches l.1930 verbatim, apart from line wrapping and one doubled space. CHECKED (1): the restated Prop is GX.TroyanovTheorem. A MetaM probe imported GX.Spherical.TroyanovTwoPi and GXScaffold.Spherical.TroyanovAngles and pasted the module source, so it elaborated from source. It took the conclusion of troyanovTheorem_of_exists_gt_two_pi, which is non-dependent with no loose bvars. That conclusion is Expr-equal (==) and defeq to the value of GX.TroyanovTheorem (TroyanovAngles.lean:229-232), and `example (h : Hgt) : GX.TroyanovTheorem := GX.troyanovTheorem_of_exists_gt_two_pi h` typechecks. The probe then telescoped TroyanovTheorem's value into s, θ, h and body B. It instantiated troyanovTheorem_of_lt_two_pi, troyanovTheorem_of_le_two_pi and troyanovTheorem_four_le_of_lt_two_pi (with an extra fvar hs : 4 ≤ s) at s, θ, h. Each leaves exactly one extra hypothesis, `∀ i, θ i < 2π` (resp. `≤ 2π`), and a body Expr-equal to B. The conclusion of exists_isConeSphere_of_subcritical, with s and θ substituted, is also Expr-equal to B. CHECKED (2): the hypotheses are honest restrictions. The probe elaborated each full statement independently: Hlt, Hle, H4 (4 ≤ s, all < 2π), Hgt (4 ≤ s, all ≠ 2π, some > 2π) and Hsub. Each is defeq to the corresponding theorem's type. The one structural difference is an abstracted instance proof (Nat.AtLeastTwo for the numeral 2, aux _proof_1) in the probe's own defs, not in the theorems. None is stronger than the theorem: `TroyanovTheorem → Hlt/Hle/H4/Hgt` is `fun h _ (_) θ hθ .. => h θ hθ` in each case. None is vacuous. troyanovAngleCondition_four_lt_two_pi gives (6π/5, 5π/4, 4π/3, 7π/5) at s = 4, pairwise distinct, all < 2π, with χ' = 71π/60 ≤ 6π/5 (arithmetic re-checked by hand), and the probe proved that the remaining case of Hgt is inhabited by (5π/2, 3π/5, 3π/5, 3π/5) (χ' = 3π/10). CHECKED (3): exists_isConeSphere_of_subcritical. Its binders are s, 3 ≤ s, θ, ∀ i 0 < θ i, ∀ i θ i < 2π, 0 < χ', and ∀ j χ' < 2θ_j, where χ' = ∑(θ_i − 2π) + 4π. The probe proved these independently from TroyanovAngleCondition θ ∧ ∀ i, θ i < 2π: 3 ≤ s is h.1, 0 < χ' is h.2.1, and θ_j > 0 by χ' ≤ θ_j. Then χ' ≤ θ_j < 2θ_j. This is the derivation the file uses at l.2115-2116. The hypotheses are genuinely weaker: exists_isConeSphere_four_not_troyanovAngleCondition proves ¬TroyanovAngleCondition for (3π/2, 3π/2, 3π/2, 3π/5) (χ' = 11π/10 > 3π/5) while the subcritical hypotheses hold (11π/10 < 6π/5). Its conclusion is TroyanovTheorem's body at θ. CHECKED (4): the polygon and the double. exists_sphPolygon : … → ∃ t : SphPolygon s, t.α = α. SphPolygon.isConeSphere : IsConeSphere t.PolyDouble (fun i => 2 * t.α i) t.vertex, and isConePoint_vertex : IsConePoint (t.θc i) (t.vertex i), with θc i = ⟨2 * t.α i, _⟩. The vertex chart is built on polarFold (t.α i), the sector of angle α_i. The subcritical theorem calls exists_sphPolygon at α_i = θ_i/2 and rewrites (fun i => 2 * t.α i) = θ (l.2107), so the cone angles are 2·θ_i/2 = θ_i with no factor lost. The structure's gram field ⟨n_{b i}, n_{a i}⟩ = −cos α_i makes α_i the interior angle of the wedge {⟨n_a,x⟩ ≥ 0, ⟨n_b,x⟩ ≥ 0}, which is π − arccos(−cos α_i). The kernel ties the angle anyway, through the XAChart from C_{θc i}, and the strict IsConePoint.angle_eq (ConeSurface.lean:921) makes it unique. Nothing is redefined. Every GX constant in the statements of troyanovTheorem_of_lt_two_pi, exists_isConeSphere_of_subcritical and troyanovTheorem_of_exists_gt_two_pi is imported: IsConeSphere from GX.Spherical.ConeSurface, TroyanovAngleCondition from GX.SingularII.Models, SingularGXStructure from GX.Singular.Atlas, SO3/Sph2 from GX.Spherical.S3Model. The file defines no IsConePoint/IsConeSphere/XAChart; its own types are SphPolygon and PolyDouble (a synonym of Sph2), and its singularGXStructure is the maximal a.e. atlas of cone charts whose compatibility (isGXAtlas_atlas) and portly support (isAEAtlas_atlas) are proved. The REPORT's findings are true and none is presented as an error in the paper. (a) For s = 4 the printed condition is sufficient, not necessary: this is kernel-checked, the paper says only 'as long as', and the REPORT refrains from asserting MR1005085's bound, leaving that to T-gx-troyanov-source. (b) The remark that the planner's 'by continuity in the radius' needs two cases (G = H vs G + H = 2π) is a remark on method for the planner, not for the author. A single IVT on cos G − cos H over a subinterval where G < 2π would also do, so 'not enough' is a matter of formulation, not an error. (c) Non-vacuity is kernel-checked.

docstring_contract: The contract is lean-causal kb 0006, the one CAMPAIGN.md points to; lean-gx's own kb 0006 is the spherical-models entry. Present and in order: the title; the label `cex:start_singular_manifold_homeomorphic` — `RamcovGX.tex:1930`, unmarked, at char 314; the quoted block (verbatim); an extra '## The construction' section (char 2763); '## Hypothesis checklist' (char 4182); '## SCOPE (disclosed)' (a)-(d) (char 4712); and the Provenance line (char 5507). The construction section is accurate, checked by hand. With α = θ/2 and β = π − α, χ' = 4π − 2∑β, so χ' > 0 ⇔ ∑β < 2π and χ' < 2θ_k ⇔ 2β_k < ∑β. The gap formula is the spherical law of cosines. H(β_max/2) = π and the gaps at r = π/2 are the β_i (chordGap_half, chordGap_pi_div_two). The two IVT cases have the right signs at both ends. The triple product is polVec_triple. The checklist is true. Its first row has no ✓/⚠ symbol. Its third row reads '⚠ restricted: all θ_i < 2π', which plays the role of the contract's '⚠ strengthened' and is disclosed in SCOPE (a) and in the label bullet. The second row's 'carried verbatim' holds for the principal theorems; the subcritical theorem assumes less, and the first-page bullet and SCOPE (c) say so. The SCOPE claims are all true. (a): < 2π only, ≤ 2π through TwoPi. (b): the chart is def:atlas's, onto a connected open neighbourhood of the apex. (c): sufficiency only, and the planner's 'iff' is not proved. (d): the Prop is restated inline (Expr-equal, CHECKED (1)), with M : Type. The Provenance cross-references are all used in the file and resolve: frameSO3, polarFold, isOpenMap_restrict_of_isCompact, symm_trans_mem_aeAtlas_of_opens, isPortly_compl_singleton_sph2, IsConeSphere.insertNth (l.2142), troyanovTheorem_of_four_le_of_ne_two_pi (l.2154) and intermediate_value_Icc (l.266). The header gloss '(DEC-136, Troyanov's theorem proved, not assumed)' is the same as in the graduated TroyanovTriangle/TroyanovTwoPi. l.7 and the label bullet disclose that nothing is marked and that the row stays partial, so the gloss is not counted as a finding. One trivial docstring imprecision is not counted: exists_polar_polygon's docstring says 'm ≥ 2', which its statement does not assume. The hypotheses are unsatisfiable for m < 2, so the statement is the same.
